title: Amyl Nitrite
text: This remedy is characterized by its powerful action on the circulatory system, producing rapid and intense flushing and heat. It is especially indicated in cases of angina pectoris and flushing during menopause. There is a general feeling of fullness and throbbing in the head and heart. The characteristic symptom is a sudden flushing of the face and upper part of the body. Intense flushing of the face and head. Throbbing headache. Sensation of fullness and pressure. Vertigo. Eyes red and bloodshot. Dimness of vision. Sensation of heat. Sudden flushing, becoming deep red or purple. Sensation of heat. Sensation of constriction in the throat. Difficulty in swallowing. Shortness of breath. Wheezing. Sensation of suffocation. Rapid and deep breathing. Violent palpitation. Throbbing in the region of the heart. Angina pectoris. Rapid and full pulse. Flushing during menopause. Profuse sweating. Worse from motion and in a warm room. Better from open air and cold applications. Compare: Glonoinum; Lachesis; Belladonna. Third to sixth potency. Also by inhalation of a few drops.
